Bolder: Brand vs Product Distinction
nodes.rationale: In brand contexts bolder means distinctive (extreme scale, unexpected color, typographic risk); in product contexts bolder means stronger hierarchy and clarity, not theatrics, because theatrics undermine trust.

nodes.label: Animate: Brand vs Product Motion Register
nodes.rationale: Brand surfaces favor one well-rehearsed motion entrance over scattered micro-interactions, rejecting the saturated fade-and-rise-on-scroll default; product surfaces favor 150-250ms task-feedback motion with no page-load choreography since users are mid-task.

nodes.rationale: Mood lives in brand colors (primary+accent) and typography, not surface; pure white/black bg defaults avoid the 'AI cliché' of warming both primary and bg.
